notices.text: The doors your door server offers are now chosen by collection instead of the Available to Door Server setting on each door. Every door you had marked is still offered: it is ticked in each collection it belongs to, a collection that holds one is now shown to Both (your callers and the door server), and a marked door that was in no collection is in a new collection called Door Server, shown to the door server only. Nothing else in those collections is offered. Review them under Admin > Doors > Door Collections.
